disabled.body-background: TEMPORARY: the placeholder app has no web document shell yet, so <body> keeps its transparent default (screens paint their own backgrounds). Re-enable once the app shell sets the body background from the --ms-* tokens.
disabled.body-font: TEMPORARY: same cause; <body> falls back to the browser serif because only react-native-web Text elements get the system font stack. Text inside main is still checked by text-font. Re-enable once the app shell sets the body font.
disabled.fonts-loaded: TEMPORARY: the app renders with the platform system font stack and declares no web font, so document.fonts is empty by design. fonts-error still runs. Re-enable if a web font is added with expo-font.

disabled.skip-link: React Native Web mobile app: there is no repeated header or nav block before the content to skip past, and a skip link has no native iOS/Android equivalent. Tab bars are reached by the platform's own navigation.
